name: The Copycat
source:
After your father was murdered in a brutal killing, you thought the relentless bullying at school would slow down, but it only got worse. While struggling to fit in, can you become popular or will you watch your bully spoil the family you have left?

当你的父亲在一次残酷的杀戮中被谋杀后，你以为学校里无情的欺凌行为会减缓，但情况只会变得更糟。在努力融入社会的过程中，你能变得受欢迎还是会眼睁睁地看着你的恶霸破坏你留下的家庭？
